extraction.Name: Nellie Stirk Lessert
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want the patent in fee to her 156.42 acre allotment, when it was issued, April 13, 1918, but the Indian Agency told her that it would be taxed, and sold for same, if she did not take it, and keep the taxes paid up on it, so she accepted the patent in fee
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: in 1919, she sold her allotment to Emma Stirk, of Scenic, South Dakota, for $1500.00, cash; and that she considers that she received a fair price for her land
extraction.Buyer: Emma Stirk, of Scenic, South Dakota, for $1500.00 cash
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: did not sell her land for any debts incurred prior to receiving the patent in fee
extraction.Occupation/Income: her husband ranches for their living, this being their only income
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, health good; mother of two children who have good health; husband has good health; has never received any help from the County, State nor the United States Government; allotment was 156.42 acres; document sworn March 11, 1929
